result.title: A Systematic Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal Personalized Reasoning of Vision-Language Models
result.summary: People often make decisions by holistically reasoning over heterogeneous forms of personal information. In this paper, we study the relatively underexplored capability of multimodal personalized reasoning in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). To this end, we introduce \texttt{MPRBench}, a novel and comprehensive benchmark specifically designed to evaluate personalized reasoning across a wide range of tasks and real-world challenges. \texttt{MPRBench} consists of 12 sub-tasks and additionally supports interpretable analysis of representative error cases. Through extensive experiments, we find that current personalized MLLMs still struggle with personalized reasoning due to several key challenges, including inaccurate recognition of personalized concepts and sensitivity to irrelevant personal information. We hope that MPRBench will stimulate further research on personalized reasoning in MLLMs. Code and data are available at https://github.com/kkdh15/MPRBench

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 MPRBench，一个用于系统评测多模态大模型个性化推理的基准，包含 12 个子任务并支持对代表性错误案例的可解释分析，实验发现模型在个性化概念识别和无关个人信息干扰下仍表现不佳。
AI.relevance_reason: 「个性化概念识别不准」与「对无关个人信息敏感」正对应 LVR 关心的视觉细节保留与证据筛选问题，可供核查是否能作为诊断任务；但论文聚焦基准评测，未涉及内部状态或推理期 latent 生成。
